    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::cin.ignore(); // ignore newline after n
    std::string ip;
    std::getline(std::cin, ip);
    int wordCount = 0;
    int longestWord = 0;
    bool insideBraces = false;
    std::string sb;
    for (int i = 0; i < n && i < (int)ip.length(); ++i) {
        char ch = ip[i];
        if (ch == '_' || ch == '(' || ch == ')') {
            int len = sb.length();
            if (len > 0) {
                if (insideBraces) wordCount++;
                else longestWord = std::max(longestWord, len);
            }
            sb.clear();
            if (ch == '(') insideBraces = true;
            if (ch == ')') insideBraces = false;
        } else if ((ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') || (ch >= 'A' && ch <= 'Z')) {
            sb.push_back(ch);
        }
    }
    int len = sb.length();
    if (len > 0) {
        if (insideBraces) wordCount++;
        else longestWord = std::max(longestWord, len);
    }
    std::cout << longestWord << " " << wordCount << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
